## Problem and approach

Describe the user problem, capability semantics, and implementation approach.

## Application compatibility

List adapters, exact native application versions, operating systems, and unsupported cases tested.

## Safety and verification

- [ ] Inputs remain unchanged and existing outputs fail closed by default.
- [ ] Relevant Python and/or browser tests were added or updated.
- [ ] Formatting, Ruff, mypy, pytest, site checks, builds, and dependency audit pass.
- [ ] Documentation, examples, and changelog match public behavior.
- [ ] No secrets, private documents, or incompatible assets are included.
